title: portal
description: A boundary-determined morphism φ : P → W from a hole (pool) P into a world W. By (PM1) the value at any interior point of P depends only on that point's germ at the boundary ∂P — only boundary information crosses, nothing of the hole's deep interior. The controlled inter-world connection; pushforward φ_* along a chosen traveller fibration realizes the inter-world jump.

from-hole.description: the hole (pool) P the portal opens from

into-world.description: the world W the portal opens into

boundary-determined.description: (PM1) φ(p) = φ(q) whenever p, q share their germ at ∂P
